Usage: g connect --host=HOST --path=PATH --port=INT --mirror=MIRROR --into=INTO [flags]

Connect to a host.

Flags:
      --user=USER            Account name.
      --password=PASSWORD    Account password.
      --token=TOKEN          API token.
      --host=HOST            Host (required).
      --path=PATH            Path (required).
      --port=INT             Port (required).
      --mirror=MIRROR        Mirror to copy (required).
      --local=LOCAL          Local directory.
      --into=INTO            Destination (required).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help                 Show context-sensitive help.

Constraints:
  At most one of --user, --token.
  All or none of --user, --password.
  At most one of --mirror, --local.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
